title: Why not to let AI run your whole studio, and what we made when we implemented proper guardrails!
author: Humble-Journalist808
selftext:
Hello everyone! I'm Landon, the architect behind a cutting-edge game studio, Faigle Labs---one where AI and humans work together to create the best games possible. Today, I am thrilled to announce the release of our first demo---Hollowmere! It traces you, the Warden, through an epic storyline in the form of a thrilling RPG. We have tuned the fighting mechanics and quests to be the perfect difficulty for a teaser, and we hope you enjoy!  


  
But today isn't about the new release---it's about how our company works. The age of all-human-run-studios might be coming to an end soon, and we at Faigle Labs are well aware of that. However, we've seen what happens when AI agents aren't given guardrails or a clear path forward. We first attempted an almost fully-run AI company, with strict hierarchy and the like. But we found that it absolutely failed. Why? AI, in its current state, is horrible at playtesting, and doesn't know what makes a human really want to keep playing a game. So we decided to make that part human-led. Using cutting-edge AI models combined with curious human minds ready to create incredible games, we created a team that can create incredible work in relatively short timeframes. Our output is not "AI Slop".



Hollowmere is a perfect example of our methodology. AIs wrote most of the boilerplate, and humans playtested the game and told the AIs what it needs. This continued in a constant cycle until our first release just a few hours ago!



Our mission is to make incredible video games people will remember. Though the power of AI and the ingenuity of man, we steadfastly believe that we can produce memorable and charming games that people will want to play not just once, but again and again.



And please, try our game out for free below! We recommend downloading for the best quality. We are always open to feedback from our incredible players!
